This suggests that future self-verification should prioritize \emph{architectural diversity} over scale---a small, specialized verifier with independent training signal outperforms a larger model from the same family. Our formal analysis assumes source-attribution scoring; alternative attribution schemes that decouple constraints from their originating traces could alter the degeneration condition, though no such scheme has been proposed.
